title: SignAligner: Dual-Granularity Span Generation for Sign Language Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.22409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large sign-language corpora benefit from temporal labels at two scales: subtitle spans for subtitle alignment and word spans for sign spotting. Sign spottings already locate words in time at corpus scale, but training subtitle alignment jointly on subtitle and word spans remains underexplored. We present SignAligner, a prompt-conditioned visual-language span generator that maps a sign-language video and a subtitle-sentence or target-word query to a textual start/end frame interval. It is first trained jointly on subtitle spans and word spans from sign spottings, then refined with overlap-based rewards while retaining auxiliary word examples. On the subtitle test set of the British Broadcasting Corporation-Oxford British Sign Language (BOBSL) corpus, the refined model reaches 66.68 F1@0.50 (F1 with a temporal intersection-over-union threshold of one half), the best among compared systems without external sign-video resources. translated_title: SignAligner：面向手语对齐的双粒度片段生成
translated_abstract: 大型手语语料库受益于两种尺度的时间标注：用于字幕对齐的字幕片段和用于手语词定位的词片段。手语词定位已经能够在语料库规模上实现词的时间定位，但同时在字幕片段和词片段上联合训练字幕对齐的研究仍然不足。我们提出了SignAligner，这是一个基于提示条件的视觉-语言片段生成器，它将手语视频以及字幕句子或目标词查询映射为文本形式的起止帧区间。该模型首先在手语词定位得到的字幕片段和词片段上进行联合训练，然后利用基于重叠度的奖励进行优化，同时保留辅助词样本。在英国广播公司-牛津英国手语（BOBSL）语料库的字幕测试集上，优化后的模型达到了66.68 F1@0.50（时间交并比阈值为0.5时的F1值），在不使用外部手语视频资源的对比系统中表现最佳。
tldr: 提出SignAligner，一个基于提示的视觉-语言片段生成器，通过在手语词定位的字幕片段与词片段上联合训练并采用基于重叠度的奖励优化，在不使用外部手语视频资源的情况下实现了最佳的手语字幕对齐效果。
en_tdlr: SignAligner is a prompt-conditioned visual-language span generator that jointly trains on subtitle and word spans from sign spottings with overlap-based reward refinement, achieving the best sign-language subtitle alignment performance without external sign-video resources.
